tools_helpful.evidence: session-log turns 24-34: scaffold pre-seeded TODO[migrate-005..008] routing to PATTERNS.md#getforcurrentview / #threading, which the agent resolved one by one (Dispatcher.RunAsync -> DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue).
Agent rebuilt after each batch of fixes to surface the next error (CS0227, CS1061); build finally succeeded (build-output.txt: BUILD SUCCEEDED).

tools_problematic.problem: Classified CaptureElement as 'unsupported' -> collapsed the whole camera-preview file to triage label 'defer'. The agent had to override the triage and migrate the preview anyway to reach parity.
tools_problematic.evidence: inventory 'unsupported' list contained CaptureElement; agent replaced PreviewControl.Source=_mediaCapture with a GetPreviewFrameAsync DispatcherTimer loop (turns 33-35) instead of deferring.

tool_limitations.limitation: Because CaptureElement was 'unsupported', a successfully-migrated camera preview would be flagged as un-deferred residue.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Reclassify CaptureElement as 'adaptable' with a camera-preview anchor so a migrated preview is expected, not flagged.

failed_apis.why_tried: Direct UWP live-preview pattern carried over from the sample.
failed_apis.root_cause: No CaptureElement control exists in WinUI 3; MediaCapture.Source has no XAML host.
failed_apis.fix: Replaced with an <Image> + DispatcherTimer GetPreviewFrameAsync loop converting SoftwareBitmap to a SoftwareBitmapSource.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP sample released/re-acquired the camera on app suspend/resume.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 desktop Application has no Suspending/Resuming events (CS1061).
failed_apis.fix: Removed the subscriptions and moved cleanup/init into Window.Activated (WindowActivationState.Deactivated).

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP sample used SMTC SoundLevel==Muted as a 'app minimized' signal.
failed_apis.root_cause: No per-view SMTC singleton in WinUI 3 desktop.

doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### CS0246 / CaptureElement could not be found'
doc_errors.wrong: States there is 'no compatible replacement' and the file 'should be marked defer'.
doc_errors.correct: Live camera preview IS migratable via a GetPreviewFrameAsync->Image frame loop or MediaPlayerElement+MediaFrameSource; deferring drops a working feature.

doc_errors.wrong: Covers OnLaunched/OnActivated/OnFileActivated only; silent on Suspending/Resuming.
doc_errors.correct: Suspending/Resuming do not exist in WinUI 3 desktop and map to Window.Activated.

special_apis.special_handling: Used as the CaptureElement replacement; frame must be converted to Bgra8/Premultiplied SoftwareBitmap and pushed to an Image via SoftwareBitmapSource on the UI thread.

errors_encountered.error: CS0227: Unsafe code may only appear if compiling with /unsafe
errors_encountered.root_cause: Pixel-buffer access in the camera/effect code uses unsafe blocks; scaffold csproj omits AllowUnsafeBlocks.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending' / 'Resuming'
errors_encountered.root_cause: WinUI 3 Application has no suspend/resume lifecycle events.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246 / WMC0001 CaptureElement could not be found
errors_encountered.fix: Migrated preview to an Image frame loop instead of deferring.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Subscribed to Application.Current.Suspending/Resuming, hit CS1061, kept the UWP handlers for several turns before realizing they are UWP-only.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill lifecycle section never states Suspending/Resuming are gone or what replaces them.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed the subscriptions and rewired teardown/init through Window.Activated.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A PATTERNS.md lifecycle subsection on Suspending/Resuming->Window.Activated plus an analyzer TODO so the file is flagged up front.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Had to decide whether to honor the 'defer' triage or migrate; chose to migrate with a bespoke frame loop.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill/inventory told it to defer CaptureElement, but parity requires a live preview.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Reclassify CaptureElement as adaptable and document the frame-loop replacement so the path is the default, not an override.

env_issues.issue: No camera on the build/scoring box; GetPreviewFrameButton stays disabled in both UWP and WinUI.
env_issues.workaround: Hardware-gated control is dead in both apps, so it is not a regression (rubric notes this).
